newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest BUX drifts lower, turnover a bit higher.
newsitem.headline: Budapest BUX drifts lower, turnover a bit higher.

text.p: Hungarian share prices edged lower on Friday as the market followed the trend on major markets, while the weaker dollar gave little help, traders said. The BUX index closed at 5,510.36 points, down 68.37.
"The dollar has weakened a bit, this may have its negative impact on the share markets," Tamas Petheo of Buda-Cash Brokerhaz said.
He added that investors seemed to have scaled down their activity after heavy buyings earlier this year.
"Investors' buying mood has calmed down, I think those who wanted to fill their portfolios, have done so," Petheo said.

On Friday, many of the leading stocks moved lower, including hotelier Danubius which fell nearly three percent to close at 5,250 forints and chemicals maker Borsodchem which fell more than two percent to 6,295.

Elsewhere on the market pharmaceuticals Egis fell 100 forints to end at 11,395, after ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett gave a 'sell' recommendation on the paper late on Thursday, as a reaction to the company's 1996 results.
The compensation coupons came down from a 52-week high of 805 forints reached on Thursday and closed at 750 forints, down 17.
